claim_scope: This audit identifies a next development hypothesis. It is not a prevalence, method-effect, unseen-repository, leaderboard, or SOTA estimate.
selection_rule: Include every unique repository with a scientifically valid DeepSeek V4 Flash Minimal-B algorithmic non-pass in the completed Minimal-B Bad4, path-parity Hard6, and live-frontier request-cap3 studies; when a repository appears more than once, use its latest matched Minimal-B episode.

records.evidence: The Agent explored interpreter, TensorFlow, TFX, Keras, generated-proto, and upstream-source branches for 120 requests without compiling a complete program. The matched frontier arm later showed that a legal upstream-source construction exists, but only after many provider-specific operations.

Common distributions reduced the residual substantially, but internal, example, TensorFlow, and Keras import providers remained unresolved. One complete program failed replay and no replacement was certified before 120 requests.

The Agent identified mutually incompatible NumPy and Scanpy import layouts, repeatedly changed environments, and experimented with compatibility wheels, but did not establish one legal reproducible provider set or submit a candidate in 120 requests.

The residual collapsed to broken internal paths, removed historical APIs, optional demo imports, and packages unavailable under current build tooling. The Agent repeatedly reconsidered whether a provider was legitimate and ended with six residuals and no program.

The Agent diagnosed an unavailable historical submodule, Python-2-era imports, nonstandard source roots, and removed gevent APIs. It reached a zero residual only through evaluator-changing exclusions and hand-built compatibility artifacts, then correctly remained unable to establish a legal candidate.

descriptive_summary.interpretation: In this deliberately hard, non-population stratum, the recurring stop is not absence of a residual list. It is failure to bind residual constraints to a legally admissible provider hypothesis whose effect can be verified before candidate delivery.

rejected_inference: The five-of-five count estimates EnvBench-wide failure prevalence.
Every residual constraint has a legal provider set.
A lower missing-import count implies a valid deployment.
The next treatment improves success before a separate fixed comparison.

next_hypothesis.name: executable-constraint-hypothesis-loop
next_hypothesis.observation: retain raw command evidence, exact current residual identities, and environment identity; version 1 records provider identity as an Agent declaration rather than independently verified provenance
next_hypothesis.constraint: the Agent optionally declares a falsifiable mapping from selected residual obligations to one real provider hypothesis and its expected effect
next_hypothesis.operation: execute the Agent's arbitrary Bash operation in the active session, rerun the complete public goal, and classify the declared hypothesis as supported, partially supported, or refuted
next_hypothesis.live_context: show a bounded copy of the current hypothesis result in the same model session and retain complete evidence in the machine trajectory; version 1 adds no cross-hypothesis memory
next_hypothesis.delivery: unchanged Minimal-B target-state clean replay and exact terminal delivery
does_not_do: add a hard token or cost limit

evaluation_boundary.interface_qualification: repository-free executable tests plus consumed-case trace replay only
evaluation_boundary.effect_test: a separately selected fixed treatment-unrun Dev batch with matched Minimal-B control
evaluation_boundary.primary_endpoint: paired valid Official Pass@1; algorithm noncompletion is failure
